source: EPREL, the EU's product registry for energy labelling: its public search of electronic displays (https://eprel.ec.europa.eu/api/products/electronicdisplays, by trademark, newest on the market first), for each brand the TV catalog sells; televisions placed on the market from 2021, one row a model identifier at its latest version. A row's label is at https://eprel.ec.europa.eu/qr/<eprel>.
field: onModeWatts is powerOnModeSDR, the on-mode power demand in SDR in watts that the energy label prints; sizeIn is the registry's diagonal in whole inches; onMarket the first day it was placed on the market
